description: An API token without its secret

id.description: Token ID, used to revoke it

name.description: Name the owner gave the token; unique among the owner's tokens, ignoring case

prefix.description: npmpro_ and the token's lookup id, shown to tell tokens apart

visibility.description: Which items the token sees: `user` only the items its owner created, `all` every item

proxy_hosts.description: Level for Proxy Hosts: manage, view or hidden

redirection_hosts.description: Level for Redirection Hosts: manage, view or hidden

dead_hosts.description: Level for 404 Hosts: manage, view or hidden

streams.description: Level for Streams: manage, view or hidden

access_lists.description: Level for Access Lists: manage, view or hidden

certificates.description: Level for Certificates: manage, view or hidden

permissions.description: Access level of the token for each section; never above its owner's current level

admin.description: Whether the token acts as an administrator for the admin areas (settings, audit log, backups, monitoring); never for user management or the sign-in settings

allow_delete.description: Whether the token may delete: DELETE requests, replace restores and the MCP delete tools

expires_on.description: When the token stops working, ISO time in UTC; null for a token that never expires

last_used_on.description: When the token was last used, ISO time in UTC, updated at most once a minute; null while it was never used

created_on.description: When the token was created, ISO time in UTC

expired.description: Whether the expiry time has passed

token.description: The token text, only in the answer of the create request and never shown again

owner.description: The user the token belongs to, only in the list of every token
